name: Delney, Streetwise Lookout doubles Orcish Bowmasters's triggered ability

prerequisites.timing: whenever Orcish Bowmasters's triggered ability would trigger
other: Orcish Bowmasters's oracle text: Flash. When this creature enters and whenever an opponent draws a card except the first one they draw in each of their draw steps, this creature deals 1 damage to any target. Then amass Orcs 1.

Requires Orcish Bowmasters to have power 2 or less at the time of the trigger (Delney's ability text: "Creatures you control with power 2 or less can't be blocked by creatures with power 3 or greater. If a triggered ability of a creature you control with power 2 or less triggers, that ability triggers an additional time.") - both cards confirm this at their printed base power, but power can change from effects elsewhere in the deck (e.g. -1/-1 counters, boosts); not checked against every other card's interaction with this power threshold.

Real gameplay impact: doubles a removal/clock effect that already sees play as a top-tier disruption piece; relevant to Phase 27 win-attempt/recovery and Phase 29 interaction-burden analysis, not just a curiosity.

result.summary: Orcish Bowmasters' ETB/opponent-draw ping-and-amass trigger fires twice per qualifying event: 2 damage and Amass Orcs 2 total instead of 1 and 1.

sources.reference: Independent pairwise scan of card_cache oracle text against Delney's triggered-ability-doubling clause, 2026-08-12 (not indexed as a formal combo by Commander Spellbook - this is a value multiplier, not a win line).
